title: Process Separators
summary: Custom gas-liquid and liquid-liquid separator vessels, flash drums and oil-water separators designed around project-specific process data and mechanical requirements.
body:
Tongyang fabricates custom process separator vessels for specified flow rates, fluid properties and operating conditions. The vessel orientation, dimensions and internal components depend on the separation objective, phase behavior, allowable carryover, pressure drop and required liquid holdup. Process sizing and performance responsibilities are confirmed for each project.

Types of process separation equipment

  • Gas-liquid separators: for defined two-phase separation duties
  • Flash drums and knockout vessels: for specified vapor-liquid disengagement services
  • Oil-water separators: for liquid-liquid separation duties based on the feed properties and required outlet quality
  • Two-phase and selected three-phase separators: subject to confirmed process data and design scope
  • Custom separator vessels: with specified internals, nozzles and instrumentation interfaces

Industries and applications

  • Oil and gas processing facilities
  • Chemical and petrochemical plants
  • Industrial utility and process systems
  • Flash, knockout and phase-disengagement duties
  • Liquid-liquid separation and oil-water handling where technically suitable

Key technical parameters for quotation

  • Feed conditions: normal, minimum and maximum flow rates, composition, phase fractions and expected operating range
  • Fluid properties: gas and liquid density, viscosity, surface tension where available, corrosive components and solids loading
  • Separation targets: required outlet quality, droplet or particle criteria, allowable carryover and pressure drop
  • Mechanical conditions: operating/design pressure and temperature, corrosion allowance and material requirements
  • Configuration: horizontal or vertical orientation, liquid holdup, level-control requirements and drainage arrangement
  • Scope: inlet device, demister, coalescer or baffles where specified, nozzles, instruments, valves and skid interfaces

Mechanical fabrication and applicable standards

Vessel materials, welding, inspection, non-destructive examination and pressure testing are defined by the agreed mechanical specification and applicable design code. ASME Section VIII, GB/T 150 or other codes may be considered where applicable to the project. Required certification and destination-market conformity are evaluated separately and confirmed in the quotation.

Internal separation components and process performance depend on the approved process basis. Any process sizing, internals selection, separation-efficiency guarantee or package integration must have clearly defined engineering responsibility and agreed acceptance criteria.

Related equipment

Depending on the process, a separator may be used with pressure-containing drums or downstream heat-transfer equipment. See our industrial pressure vessels and heat exchangers and coolers for related equipment categories.

Preparing a separator RFQ

For an initial review, provide a process data sheet, stream table or PFD/P&ID, including flow rates, fluid composition, operating and design conditions, required outlet quality, materials and applicable code. Please also identify whether the requested scope includes internals, instruments, valves, controls or skid-mounted equipment.

Quotation basis: final vessel sizing, internals, process performance, inspection, testing, certification and package scope are subject to technical review and confirmation of the project specification.
